title: SCNet P0 R06k 800 m/s fragment negative-volume PSFAIL isolation
purpose: Test whether the 35 remaining R06j fragment deletions are entirely caused by the negative-volume failure criterion automatically activated by ERODING contact.

provenance.identity_rule: Mesh, IDs, post-explosion initial state, both MAT_015 definitions including fragment EROD=1, EOS, contact, section, boundaries, speed, termination, timestep, outputs and resources remain identical to Job 72751725. Only CONTROL_SOLID PSFAIL changes 0 to 910001.
provenance.factor_scope: CONTROL_SOLID Card 1 field 5 PSFAIL only, 0 to plate-only set 910001

symmetry.validity: normal incidence, face-on cube, centered impact only

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_binary_policy: Set NEIPH=6 and explicitly preserve all other R15.0.2 documented Card 1/Card 2 defaults; Card 2 is mandatory.

damage_source.sentinel_policy: absolute value at or above 1e29 is unavailable with a reason, never zero

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_d3part_policy: Explicit NEIPH=6 request is a redundant-channel experiment; full D3PLOT HVAR6 remains authoritative.

paired_experiments.question: Does excluding fragment part 2002 from the ERODING-contact negative-volume failure criterion remove the 35 remaining deletions?

preregistered_evaluation.single_factor_rule: The R06k deck may differ from returned R06j only in TITLE and CONTROL_SOLID Card 1 field 5 PSFAIL, 0 to plate-only part set 910001.

solver_semantics.eroding_contact_side_effect: ERODING contact automatically activates a negative-volume failure criterion for solid elements
solver_semantics.psfail_scope: A nonzero PSFAIL part-set ID restricts that criterion to solids in the named part set
solver_semantics.treatment_effect: PSFAIL=910001 keeps the criterion on plate part 1002 and excludes fragment part 2002
solver_semantics.source: Ansys LS-DYNA Explicit Technical Guide, ERODING contact and PSFAIL guidance

interpretation_rules.fragment_deletion_removed_but_distortion: supports negative-volume erosion as the remaining deletion path and demonstrates that simple deletion suppression is not a production remedy
interpretation_rules.fragment_deletion_persists: refutes exclusive attribution and requires another deletion-path audit
interpretation_rules.normal_completion_without_fragment_delet: still does not establish physical validity because the treatment suppresses a numerical failure criterion
interpretation_rules.primary_qoi_policy: never promote PSFAIL-isolation response values to physical labels, calibration targets or reference data

submission_sequence.wave_0_gate: Target parser/resource identity and no mass scaling are required. Normal completion is not assumed: timestep collapse, severe distortion or solver termination must be preserved as diagnostic evidence.
submission_sequence.hold_after_wave_0: Do not release 2000 m/s, treatments, fitting or labels. Audit the negative-volume mechanism first.
submission_sequence.resource_identity: Use exactly one node, 32 ranks, LS-DYNA R15 MPP double precision, and the same memory settings as Job 72751725.

deferred_not_generated.reason: Deferred until the PSFAIL-only mechanism isolation is audited.
Model-form redesign is premature before the deletion path is isolated.
Hold until numerical deletion and response availability are resolved.

claim_boundary: R06j partially suppressed fragment deletion but left exactly 35 negative-volume-driven fragment deletions.
R06k changes only PSFAIL from 0 to plate-only set 910001, excluding fragment part 2002 from the ERODING-contact negative-volume criterion.
Fragment MAT_015 EROD remains 1 and the contact formulation remains ERODING_SINGLE_SURFACE.
The model continues to start from the same post-explosion fragment state.
Any R06k result is mechanism evidence only and cannot authorize engine fitting, damage-tree fitting or dataset admission.

explosion_instant_start_policy.r06h_rule: initial geometry, velocity and all other state remain byte-equivalent to Job 72639935
explosion_instant_start_policy.future_full_warhead_rule: A full-warhead high-fidelity model may start at explosion time only after the mapped mass, momentum, energy, fragment-state and boundary-state transfer is frozen and audited.
